description: Send an email from a connected mailbox. There are three modes: direct (to, subject and body), an existing draft (draftId), or a reply (replyToMessageId, optionally with replyAll) that takes its recipients, subject and threading from the original and quotes it below the body unless quoteOriginal is false. Repeating a successful send with the same idempotencyKey and arguments returns the saved result instead of sending again. Reusing a key with different arguments, or after a failed or uncertain send, returns an error. Add sendAt to any mode to schedule the message instead of sending it now. Confirm with the user when the intent is ambiguous. Scheduled mail is delivered by fluxmail serve or fluxmail scheduled run using the same store. Stdio does not deliver schedules. Overdue mail may send when a worker starts.

accountId.description: Account to operate on. Optional when exactly one account is connected.

contentId.description: Content-ID for an inline image, referenced from bodyHtml as cid:<contentId>

bodyText.description: Plain-text body. Line breaks appear in the sent email. Keep each prose paragraph on one continuous line and separate paragraphs with blank lines.

from.description: Connected address or an available send-as address

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this key when retrying the same delivery

quoteOriginal.description: With replyToMessageId: set to false to leave the original message out of the reply. Defaults to true.

replyAll.description: With replyToMessageId: reply to all original recipients

replyToMessageId.description: Message being replied to; threads correctly, quotes it below the body and computes recipients if "to" is omitted. To continue a conversation, reply to the first message get_thread returns with order newest

sendAt.description: Schedule delivery instead of sending now: ISO 8601 with timezone offset or Z (e.g. 2026-07-11T09:00:00-07:00), at most a year ahead. Fluxmail saves the message as a draft in the mailbox and sends that draft at the scheduled time. Returns a scheduleId for list/cancel.

timeZone.description: With replyToMessageId: IANA time zone, such as America/New_York, for the date above the quoted message. Defaults to the time zone setting.

name: send_email
title: Send email
